rough breathing on a short word; two analyses
iota subscript carrying an accent as well
contract verb, contraction resolved by the engine
aorist with both augment and movable nu
aorist optative of an irregular verb
neuter plural; two headwords, several inflections
ambiguous between two headwords and many cases
1sg present; also parses as an adjective form
irregular verb; also a noun form
enclitic -que, which the engine must strip
empty word; must not be an error
